meta.method: Top 20 catalog_candidates.json by rank; web/news search ±1 day; Punch, Vanguard, Guardian, ThisDay, Premium Times, Channels, Daily Trust, BBC, Reuters/AFP, CNN, ReliefWeb, FloodList, DFO, Wikipedia, LASEMA/MoE, NEMA. Read pages when reachable; headline_only when blocked or snippet-only.
notes: Accuracy over coverage: rain_no_flood_reported when no dated flood story was found, not when rain was light.
Dartmouth Flood Observatory site search did not return usable Lagos event pages for these dates.
EM-DAT was not accessible as a public browse for these dates.
Do not treat ClimaMeter’s 191 deaths (Aug 2025) as fact; Punch’s same-day story reports no such toll.
Do not treat Watchers 2017 “20 dead in Lagos” as Lagos deaths; the numbered household is Suleja/Tafa, Niger State.
Task 11 (2026-10-17): appended 10 pwr-rank records; recheck objects on 2016-10-07 and 2023-06-06; existing Task 08 fields not rewritten.

candidates.summary: Sunday 10 July 2011: ~15–20 h rain flooded Lagos; Vanguard reported 25 bodies including 11 children; Al Jazeera said at least 20 died in Lagos.
candidates.impacts: Vanguard (12 Jul 2011): 25 corpses recovered including 11 children; property 'worth several billions of Naira' destroyed; 28 families homeless in Ajegunle after four buildings caved in. Al Jazeera: at least 20 dead in Lagos; at least 29 nationwide. ReliefWeb/IFRC: 17-hour rain 10–14 July. Do not mix ReliefWeb Ibadan death figures with Lagos.
